## Get the project files

Download the [repository ZIP](https://github.com/anetaarct/thermal-conditions-reproduction-cf-publication/archive/refs/heads/main.zip) and unzip it without changing folder names. R scripts use paths relative to the project root.

| Inputs | Used for |
|---|---|
| `data_derived/smhi_hoburg_daily_temperature.csv` | Daily station observations used to build thermal windows |
| `data_derived/annual_raw_median_laying_date.csv` | Annual laying-date response for window selection |
| `data_derived/annual_main_window_temperature.csv` | Saved annual exposure used in reproductive models |
| `tables/…/*.csv` and public aggregate `.rds` files | Reproducing output tables, curves and figures without refitting |
| `data_derived/analysis/clutch_model_data.csv` | Final curated clutch-size records |
| `data_derived/analysis/fledging_model_data.csv` | Final curated egg-to-fledging records |
| `R/`, `R/browser/`, `scripts/` | Analysis and figure code |

The short input check below runs in this page using WebR (R in your browser); no installation is needed. The first run downloads the runtime to your browser.

## Saved results for this step

**Input check.** Public inputs contain 16,802 daily records, 46 annual temperatures and 45 annual laying-date summaries. The operational exposure is 26 March–7 May, 43 days each year. Run the code to check your downloaded files; execution results are displayed when the code is run.
:::







## Reproduce each step

| Step | Public inputs | What you can run or reproduce |
|---|---|---|
| Sliding-window selection | Daily SMHI data, annual laying-date summaries and aggregate cache | Candidate thermal windows, saved search diagnostics and held-out validation checks |
| Calendar-year trends | Curated model-ready records | Refit models without temperature, export coefficients, predictions and diagnostics |
| Temperature and reproductive traits | Curated model-ready records and public numerical starting values | Refit baseline models and export contrasts and predictions |
| Within–between temperature models | Curated model-ready records | Refit decomposed models, compare coefficients and inspect diagnostics |

## Refit from the public model data

The reproductive analyses used two curated datasets. Female identifiers were recoded consistently across both datasets, preserving the grouping of repeated observations. The model-ready files contain the responses and predictors used in the final analyses.

- [Download clutch-size data (CSV)](data_derived/analysis/clutch_model_data.csv)
- [Download egg-to-fledging data (CSV)](data_derived/analysis/fledging_model_data.csv)
- [Variable dictionary and centring rules](data_derived/analysis/README.md)
- [Author-side audit: 543 checks and SHA-256 checksums](tables/model_data_audit.json)
- [Numerical reproduction report: all six main models](tables/reproduction_validation.json)
- [Download the standalone reproduction runner](R/94_reproduce_from_public_data.R)
- [Download the public-data validator](R/95_validate_public_model_data.R)

Download the repository ZIP above and run these commands from its root:

```r
install.packages(c("glmmTMB", "MASS"))
```

```bash
Rscript R/95_validate_public_model_data.R
Rscript R/94_reproduce_from_public_data.R
```

The runner checks the model samples, refits the environmental model, repeats the eligible-window search with 500 independent randomisations, fits the baseline and within–between reproductive models, fits the separate temporal models, and exports contrasts, curves and conditional simulation checks. Regenerated figures are written under `figures/reproduced/`. It compares regenerated reproductive coefficients with the published exports. Published coefficients are numerical starting values; likelihood optimisation and convergence checks are rerun. No historical fitted-model object is needed.

Model checkpoints are written under `models/`; regenerated numerical results are stored under `tables/reproduced/` and `tables/within_between_20261026_reproduced/`. Original publication exports are retained. Stages can also be run separately, for example `Rscript R/94_reproduce_from_public_data.R inputs environment windows`. The available stages are `inputs`, `environment`, `windows`, `models`, `temporal`, `exports`, `figures` and `verify`. The main mixed-model fits can take substantial time; checkpoints allow completed optimisations to be reused.

The browser controls remain lightweight checks and calculations. Full mixed-model refitting uses local R, not the browser. Historical scripts that refer to earlier private paths are retained as provenance; use the standalone runner for a clean refit.

The public files begin at the final curated analysis samples, not at the raw field-data cleaning stage. The phenology-window analysis uses public annual laying-date summaries for 45 seasons, rather than the trait-specific reproductive samples. The original 500 randomised searches remain in the public cache; independent randomisations reproduce the procedure, not the exact historical permutations.

Weather covers 1980–2025 (46 seasons), the sliding-window laying-date series covers 45 seasons, clutch-size data cover 12,627 breeding attempts from 8,894 females (1981–2025, excluding 2020), and fledging data cover 9,790 attempts from 7,132 females (1981–2019).

## Verified model summaries

[Read the complete model summaries in S7](full_summaries.qmd), organised by response and model formulation.

The reproduction check matched 46 baseline/within–between coefficients to within 9.4 × 10⁻¹¹ and 17 temporal-model coefficients to within 2.6 × 10⁻⁷. Monte Carlo confidence limits can vary across numerical environments. Full R summaries from this check:

- [Clutch: baseline](tables/reproduction_checks/model_summaries/clutch_baseline.txt) · [within–between](tables/reproduction_checks/model_summaries/clutch_within_between.txt) · [without temperature](tables/reproduction_checks/model_summaries/clutch_without_temperature.txt)
- [Fledging: baseline](tables/reproduction_checks/model_summaries/fledging_baseline.txt) · [within–between](tables/reproduction_checks/model_summaries/fledging_within_between.txt) · [without temperature](tables/reproduction_checks/model_summaries/fledging_without_temperature.txt)
- [Reproduction-session software versions](tables/reproduction_checks/session_info.txt)

## Software used for the reported fits

The reported reproductive fits used R 4.6.1 and glmmTMB 1.1.14. The within–between refits and exports used R 4.6.1 and glmmTMB 1.1.15.2. Browser calculations run in WebR and base R; they reproduce the indicated checks from public files, not the historical glmmTMB fits.
